title: 2025 Logistics Innovation Program: Call for Participation
text:
Is your French logistics SME seeking a boost? The French government is launching a new support program dedicated to logistics innovation , providing crucial resources for startups and SMEs. Discover how this initiative can help your business thrive and gain a competitive edge in the evolving logistics landscape.
France Launches Initiative to Boost Logistics Innovation Paris, April 9, 2025
The Ministry of the Economy, in collaboration with France Logistics, has announced a call for applications aimed at fostering innovation within the logistics sector. The program seeks to support startups and SMEs developing cutting-edge solutions.
Program Overview In response to increasing international competition, the French government is reinforcing its dedication to nurturing innovative logistics solutions . This one-year support program offers tailored assistance to selected startups and SMEs,providing both individual and collective guidance.
Eligibility Criteria: Are You a Fit? To be eligible for this program, applicants must meet specific criteria. These requirements ensure that the support is directed toward businesses best positioned to drive meaningful change in the logistics landscape.
must be classified as a Small or Medium-sized Enterprise (SME). Must have its primary business location registered in France. Must not be older than 20 years since establishment. Must propose innovative solutions, whether technological or otherwise, addressing key challenges in the logistics sector or related fields. Solutions should demonstrate existing market traction or accomplished completion of a proof of concept with public or private backing in logistics or an adjacent sector. Winning companies must be available to present their solutions at innovation and logistics meetings in Bercy on June 13, from 9 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. How to Apply Interested parties should submit their applications through the designated online platform. The deadline for submissions is May 5 , 2025, at 11:59 p.m.
Submit your completed file via the platform Simplified procedures .
Expert Insights Logistics experts emphasize the importance of innovation in maintaining competitiveness. The French government’s initiative aligns with broader European efforts to modernize supply chains and enhance efficiency. By supporting SMEs and startups, France aims to foster a dynamic ecosystem capable of addressing future challenges in the logistics sector.
This program represents a significant opportunity for innovative companies to gain valuable support and recognition.
Industry Analyst, Logistics Innovation quarterly
